_comment: Engine and project paths are machine-specific. Edit these for your setup; build-engines.mjs refuses to run without them. Include the project you ACTUALLY WORK IN: a project that is not a target never receives a plugin improvement, and nothing says so - the editor keeps answering, on whatever binary it was last built with.

targets._why: The real game, not a test project. It was missing for a long time, and the cost was invisible: every bridge-side improvement shipped to two scratch projects while the editor doing actual work ran a plugin from days earlier. Server-side changes reach a session on restart; C++ ones only arrive through here.
targets.name: game
